artifacts.content_summary: High-level user guide for triggering EHI export. Describes export format (XML in password-protected ZIP), export scope options (single patient or population), and 4-step workflow. Contains 2 screenshots of the iClinic UI. No data dictionary, no XML schema, no field definitions, no sample data.
Screenshot rendering of PDF page 1. Shows regulatory text and export instructions.

Screenshot rendering of PDF page 2. Shows two iClinic UI screenshots: (1) Patient Data Export batch editor with radio buttons for scope selection, and (2) Patient Data Export list view showing 3 batch records (IDs 1001, 1006, 1007) with dates from 2020-2023.
